title: Slip Catching Soft Hands (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, slip catching
You are standing two metres behind the batter
The ball is going to arrive at one hundred and fifty kilometres an hour
Your hands need to be ready before your brain knows it is coming

[Verse 1]
Stand in a wide base, weight on the toes
Hands low at the start, that is how it goes
Let the catch come to you, cup it soft
Slip catching soft hands, fingers aloft

Reactive not proactive at the moment of catch
Hands move to the ball, not away from the patch
Cup the ball with both hands, give with the catch
Slip catching soft hands, the perfect match

[Pre-Chorus]
Wide base, weight forward, hands below
React to the ball, let the hands go
Give with the catch, absorb the pace
Slip catching soft hands, hold your space

[Chorus]
Slip catching soft hands, wide base low
Hands react to where the edges go
Cup and give, absorb the ball
Slip catching soft hands, take them all

[Verse 2]
Concentration between deliveries is the key
Reset after every ball, clear the memory
One slip or four slips, same technique applies
Slip catching soft hands, no surprise

[Bridge]
Bluey: An edge and it is held at second slip, brilliant catching
Trevor: The reactive hand technique and giving with the catch are the two critical elements
Chas: Son, soft hands. Every time. The ball is your guest. Welcome it in.

[Chorus]
Slip catching soft hands, wide base low
Hands react to where the edges go
Cup and give, absorb the ball
Slip catching soft hands, take them all

[Outro]
Soft hands son
Welcome the ball in
Thats my boy
